input.attributeValues: Retained production gameplay rating branches, including generated-prior provenance. No use of CA/PA.

design.tiers: Observed per-key nearest-rank p10/p50/p90; exact values reported. One key or named tightly related group varied; unrelated attributes fixed at their per-key median.
design.fixed: Same scenario, identities, initial target geometry, keeper baseline, ball physics and physical condition unless explicitly varied.
design.outcomes: Canonical action commitment/release, full advanceCoreMutable ticks for released shots and their deflections, advanceBall for staged catch/interception encounters; no forced outcomes or acceptance conversion targets.
design.executionBoundary: Shot cells run canonical released-shot perception, keeper flight reading, commitment, body movement, flight, contact and resolution until that shot ends. Other active bodies can respond through canonical AI. Passing signal cells report executePass scatter. Catch/interception cells isolate release and ball/catch resolution with stationary staged bodies, rather than making claims about collective moving-receiver AI.
design.keeperDiagnostics: keeperFlightReadTrials counts actual KEEPER_FLIGHT_READ events. keeperReachAtReleaseProbe is a deterministic preflight reach probe, not the full actual save envelope over time.
design.supersededDevelopment: The earlier development-only direct-move/advanceBall shot harness omitted canonical released-shot keeper re-aiming. Its flat keeper outcomes cannot establish weak keeper attributes and are superseded by these canonical-tick cells.
design.physicalControl: All eleven physical attributes identical across weak/average/strong technical shot, passing and reception cells. Technical reception cells vary both passer and receiver technique, holding both physical profiles and physical states equal. Real roster examples preserve all of their own attributes and are descriptive, not isolated causal comparisons.
design.sampling: Finite paired seed samples; goals, saves, fumbles and selected option may be non-monotonic despite a specific capacity effect. No claim of automatic match wins.

interceptionCells.design: 24 identical absolute lane offsets (0.25..0.595 m), 16 paired throw seeds each; ready PRESS defender; no receiver/future-state knowledge

unsupported.dribbleControl: No dedicated dribble-mistouch/lost-dribble execution uncertainty currently exists. BALL_HANDLING influences catch control and perception/choice; rule handling remains legal-state based. No new turnover lottery added.
unsupported.underusedSchema: Only keys in OUTCOURT_KEYS / KEEPER_KEYS enter these execution profiles. The schema audit separately identifies source ratings absent from this bridge.
unsupported.contactSkill: No canonical contact-success skill roll: actual body reach, technique, angle and legality decide reached containment. Defensive skill effects are approach geometry, footwork, timing and recovery.
unsupported.keeperPositioning: Positioning and set-position affect keeper anticipation/read. Short cells start with the same deliberately set body position; some group effects may therefore be weak or absent.
